title: Coming Months Covered by an Assisted Living Advance Payment
content:
The coming months an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement advance payment covers follow the household's returned payments in the 12 whole months before the handling date, counted on the assisted living account and on the customer's Larkspur independent living account under the Independent Living Residency Agreement:

| Returned payments reinstated in the window | Coming months covered |
|---|---|
| Two or more on either account | 2 |
| One on either account (and fewer than two on each) | 1 |
| None on either account | This note adds no coming month |

Each account is tested on its own count; the two counts are not added together. Every return reinstated on the account in the window counts.

**The window.** A returned payment counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the posting date: with a hypothetical handling date of 5 October 2026, a return posted on 6 October 2025 counts and one posted on 5 October 2025 does not.

### Truth table (hypothetical counts)

| Assisted living returns | Independent living returns | Coming months |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | none added |
| 1 | 0 | 1 |
| 1 | 1 | 1 |
| 0 | 2 | 2 |
| 2 | 1 | 2 |
